title: WORK-LAB Policy Projection Loss Report
description: Honest per-capability classification that a software renderer MUST emit when projecting the Global Agent Policy into native configuration. 'Rendered successfully' never implies 100% support. Only capabilities that were actually verified count toward support coverage.

native_guidance.description: Capabilities delivered as native prompt/guidance text, not machine-enforced.

workflow_guard.description: Capabilities enforced by WORK-LAB workflow guards rather than the software itself.

observe_only.description: Capabilities the software only exposes for observation, not enforcement.

unsupported.description: Capabilities this software cannot express at all.
